title: equipmentPoints
description: The collection of points mapped to the equipment.

total.description: The total number of items in the collection.

items.description: The collection of equipment point mappings.

id.description: The identifier of the mapped equipment instance.

itemReference.description: The fully qualified reference of the mapped equipment instance.

equipmentName.description: The full name of the mapped equipment instance.

shortName.description: The short name for the equipment point.

label.description: The label for the equipment point.

category.description: The category for the equipment point. This is generally unused.

isDisplayData.description: Indicates that the equipment point should be shown to an end user more prominently than other points. This value can be configured via the Equipment Definition.

equipmentUrl.description: A link to the mapped equipment.

objectUrl.description: A link to the mapped object.

objectReference.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The fully qualified reference of the mapped object.

attribute.description:
The attribute of the mapped object which the point's value represents.

The values for this property come from the `attributeEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `attributeEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/attributeEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

next.description: A link to the next page of results.

previous.description: A link to the previous page of results.

self.description: A link to this equipment point mapping collection.
